name: keys-keeper
description: Codex workflows for routing locally stored secrets through the keys CLI without returning plaintext in normal tool output.

interface.shortDescription: Route local secrets without printing their values.
interface.longDescription: Use natural-language requests to list secret metadata, inject a named key into a file, copy it with automatic clearing, open SSH sessions, and inspect audit history through the local keys CLI. This reduces accidental transcript exposure; it is not an isolation boundary against code running as the same OS user.
capabilities: Inspect secret metadata without revealing values
Route named secrets to explicit local sinks
Open SSH sessions from saved credentials
defaultPrompt: List my available keys without revealing their values.
Put my saved OpenRouter key into this project's .env file.
Connect to my saved production server over SSH.
